# Jakub Pacocha

> AI & Software Engineer at HERE Technologies and writer at From the Cabinet, based in Bydgoszcz, Poland. Building production RAG architectures, containerized ML infrastructure, and spatial intelligence systems.

## Selected Projects

- [From the Cabinet](https://fromthecabinet.com/): Philosophical & theological essay archive.
- [WideAwake](https://wideawake.jakubpacocha.com/): Zero-dependency Windows keep-awake utility (C# / .NET).
- [Ostrzółka](https://ostrzolka.vercel.app/): Municipal heritage database for NGOs.
- [OweWho](https://owewho.jakubpacocha.com/): Group expense & travel debt settlement web app.
- [Cabinet Quotes](https://quotes.fromthecabinet.com/): Distraction-free literary commonplace book.
- [Gallery](https://gallery.jakubpacocha.com/): Private photography archive.
